$comment: The ANGLE builds every Genex build bundles: scripts/bundle-angle.mjs verifies them and copies them into dist/resources/angle/<target>/<commit12>/, and the toolchain store installs that copy only when it matches (src/substrate/toolchain-store/bundled.ts). Each target is pinned by the sha256 of its manifest.json, which lists every file's size and sha256. A build's manifest records when it was built, so a rebuild never matches: all three come from the one angle.yml run named here, which CI downloads (gh run download). GitHub deletes a run's artifacts on the expiry date below: re-pin from a newer run (or publish these) before then. The swiftshader entry pins the software Vulkan a Rust Linux game ships (the Vulkan loader, SwiftShader, its ICD and their licences), split out of linux-x64-vulkan with a manifest derived from those files' bytes alone (src/substrate/toolchain-store/swiftshader-bundle.ts): the app build splits it from its bundled Linux ANGLE copy, and angle.yml uploads the same split for the owner to publish.
